mesh.repair_frame: centered source frame with longest extent one
mesh.volume_policy: preserve valid watertight boundary or padded voxel close/fill/marching cubes
mesh.surface_policy: preserve clean open surface; silhouette sheet; sealed boundary opening; explicit projected fallback except bags
mesh.pose: source repair before uniform scale before rotation; same canonical proxy for both probes
mesh.quality_gate: nonfinite, degenerate, nonmanifold, disconnected, extreme slivers, intersecting or unchecked proxy, sealed cloth, open or nonpositive MPM volume -> model_limit
mesh.self_intersection_scope: nonincident triangle SAT including coplanar; shared-vertex pairs excluded; budget exhaustion explicit
mesh.sampling_gate: actual Genesis particle count >=128 MPM / >=32 PBD; MPM thickness >=2 particle spacings

visual_binding.lod: source-colored OBJ; explicit proxy-with-source-colors fallback for fragmented or mismatched LOD
visual_binding.surface: nearest triangle barycentric, no cross-wall blending
visual_binding.volume: local affine 18 supports; bounded positive fallback when L1 weights >10
visual_binding.sampling_order: sample physics first, then replace visual fields
visual_binding.transform: same explicit source-to-solver matrix as physics

numerical_policy_inherited_from_v3.contact_dissipation: v3 hooks retained; solver surrogate, not identified material damping
numerical_policy_inherited_from_v3.pbd_bending_and_self_collision: remain disabled as in baseline; capability limitation retained
numerical_policy_inherited_from_v3.flat_recovery_reference: v3 compression-axis fallback retained; no new relaxation

compression.stimulus: full six-DOF plate pose and axis velocity prescribed each step
compression.schedule: nominal approach / hold / release; return to initial gap
compression.contact_audit: finite plate footprint and opposed contact counts; zero footprint contact -> rejected probe mismatch

diagnosis.proxy_failure: model_limit with exact defect codes and simulation_executed=false
diagnosis.unresolved_physical_failure: material_prior_or_model_limit_unresolved; do not assert causality from co-occurrence
diagnosis.not_settled: model_or_solver_limit_unresolved; no no-op viscosity patch or settle-driven plastic yield change

qualification.frozen_candidate_replay: isolates adapter changes with zero paid proposer calls; not full agent correction success
qualification.historical_v124_51pct: different 45-task cohort; cannot claim same-cohort improvement without replay

claim_boundary: Candidate geometry repair and CPU integration validation are not GPU verification, measured material truth, or production release qualification.
